turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so we have until then. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and when?
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.
Fine. I'll want a copy of that recording. Was Owen heard before that zero went into the gradebook?
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.

I haven't said one word about legal action, Hale, and I'm writing down that you threatened me with the union before answering a single question. Did anyone speak to Owen before that mark went in, yes or no?
"Choose your words carefully." That's the third thing you've said and none of them is about Owen. Answer the question, or I walk down the hall to the principal's office right now.
